name: operator-straps
description: Agent harness: PR review and commit tooling, guard hooks, run-tracking and session mods

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Skills, agents, hooks and scripts for PR review, commit breakdowns, PR summaries and worktree flow

plugins.name: pr-review-watch
plugins.description: pr-review / pr-team run tracking: Phase 5 band, engine-measured matrix and agent usage rows, bubble Stop guard

plugins.name: session-bookmark
plugins.description: Compaction bookmark: git state, last prompts and /compact instructions kept in session state and appended to the compacted conversation

plugins.name: git-status
plugins.description: Git snapshot, per-prompt GIT_STATE context and a fallback git status line that gives way to ccstatusline or band-line

plugins.name: banner-status
plugins.description: Banner options: /setup-statusline makes ccstatusline the project's status line (git branch and uncommitted changes, model, thinking effort and context window)

plugins.name: band-line
plugins.description: oStraps banner in a band above the prompt (git-status's git state, model, context window); clears git-status's own status line

plugins.name: pytest-scope
plugins.description: Routes bare pytest through the project interpreter and requires a test file or node-id per pytest run

plugins.name: todo-watch
plugins.description: The next TODO items and a live sync status line in a band above the prompt (kept until dismissed, or optionally one toast at session start), TODO_SYNC drift context and /todo, backed by the harness todo_sync checks
